subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this remain the separate canonical investigation for persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black holes, or should maintainers fold it into the guarded-lane recovery work only after same-root-cause proof exists?
rationale: The current source proves an overlapping guarded-lane stall, but the field reports add durable per-topic suppression after full restarts and session deletion, which needs maintainer judgment on proof sufficiency and recovery boundaries.

options.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

options.title: Fold Into Guarded-Lane Work After Proof
options.body: Close or merge this into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 only if maintainers confirm the same root cause explains the post-restart forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Close After Future Fix Proof
options.body: Close this later when a merged PR proves fresh non-reply forum-topic inbound messages recover after stuck-session recovery and restart.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical durable-state investigation and require live or restart-replay proof before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior Telegram isolated-ingress recovery work is the strongest owner trail for the lane, reply-fence, and restart semantics at issue.
